messages:
Noah T: Hey finance team — expense submitted by @Ava for client workshop in Lisbon. She says the cab company charged a separate booking fee and only provided an emailed receipt (no VAT number). Amount EUR 95. Card used: personal (corpcard declined). She attached the email receipt and a photo of the physical receipt. Question: can AP reimburse from an email/digital receipt without vendor VAT ID?

Riya P (Finance): Short version: we can reimburse but need either vendor VAT ID or a vendor attestation. If VAT appears on the receipt we need the tax ID to determine reclaimability. If no VAT, still need a clear description and attendee list for audit.

Carlos M (Procurement): I reached out to the cab company asking for an invoice with our company name and VAT/tax ID. They replied they only provide simple receipts and can't issue invoices due to local reg. They offered a signed letter confirming transaction details.

AP-bot: Policy reminder — for personal-card transport reimbursements > EUR 50, attach either an itemized invoice with vendor tax ID OR a vendor-signed declaration. See policy: https://redwood.infra/expenses/receipts. Use expense code `TRV-LOCAL`.

Riya P (Finance): Acceptable fallback: vendor-signed declaration + manager approval + employee statement confirming corpcard decline. Also need the photo of the receipt to show line items (fare vs booking fee). We'll reimburse in EUR equivalent to the employee's bank posting date.

Noah T: Ava uploaded a signed declaration from the cab company and included the booking reference showing company name. Her manager, Carlos, added approval in Concur. Should be good to go?

Carlos M (Procurement): Confirming I approved in Concur. Also added note: vendor is now on our local vendor list as 'Lisbon City Cabs' with exception flag for invoices.

Riya P (Finance): Great — AP can process once we have the manager approval on the expense and the vendor declaration attached. AP: please code to `6050-Local-Transport` and mark vendor exception.

AP-bot: Recorded: vendor exception created, processing queue updated. Expected reimbursement 2-4 business days after docs verified.

Noah T: Thanks all, closing the loop.
